relations.text: 約88億ドルで買収する正式契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Lowe's entered a definitive agreement to acquire Foundation Building Materials for approximately $8.8 billion

source.label: Lowe's 8-K(2025-08-20)
source.quote: today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement (the “Agreement”) to acquire Foundation Building Materials (“FBM”) for approximately $8.8 billion.

relations.text: 当年度にアーティザン・デザイン・グループの買収を完了した

source.quote: which include our current year acquisitions of Foundation Building Materials (FBM) and Artisan Design Group (ADG)

relations.text: 顧客向けの与信は、契約に基づきシンクロニー銀行が直接提供している

source.quote: Under an agreement with Synchrony Bank (Synchrony), credit is extended directly to customers by Synchrony.

source.quote: Whirlpool is a major supplier of laundry, refrigeration, cooking and dishwasher home appliances to Lowe's, a North American retailer.
